note: Render-only, derived. The board counts ITEMS (`3/8items claimed`) and never counts PEOPLE — three claims here are held by two members. Nothing on the screen says how many members have signed up. TARGETING CORRECTION (mid-run, after rev2 published to the wrong board): the first phrasing named the app but not the group, and ~zod holds a SECOND app of the same kind in ~zod/surface-seed. The bot inspected both and picked the other one. The preflight cannot catch that: it binds the SENTENCE to the record, and nothing binds the record's `channel` to the channel the bot goes on to choose. The sentence now names the group. The original phrasing is kept in `requestOriginal` so the change is visible rather than silently absorbed.
request: in the Verdict run group's potluck signup, show how many people have signed up so far
behaviour: the board states how many distinct members have claimed at least one item — a count of people, not of items
